name: num2str
expr: r1 = double(strcmp(num2str(42), "42")); r2 = double(strlength(num2str(3.14))); b1 = double(strcmp(num2str(1000000), "1000000")); b2 = double(strcmp(num2str(1000000.5), "1000000.5")); b3 = double(strcmp(num2str(123456789), "123456789")); b4 = double(strcmp(num2str(12345.678), "12345.678")); b5 = double(strcmp(num2str(pi), "3.1416")); b6 = double(strcmp(num2str(0.00012345), "0.00012345"));
comment: Sig: r = num2str(...). DEFAULT precision is MAGNITUDE-AWARE (~4 digits after the integer part), not a fixed 5 sig figs: num2str(1000000)="1000000", num2str(1000000.5)="1000000.5", num2str(123456789)="123456789", num2str(12345.678)="12345.678", num2str(pi)="3.1416". numkit previously used a fixed "%.5g" -> "1e+06" for large values; fixed 2026-05-29.
